name: Amendments
text: No modification or amendment to this Agreement shall be valid unless made in writing and signed by authorized representatives of both Parties.

legal_basis.note: Novation, rescission and alteration of contract
Oral evidence cannot vary written contract terms

title: Amendment
dispute_hotspots: Oral variation — party claims variation was agreed verbally
Course of dealing — party argues conduct constituted amendment
Unilateral amendment by platform terms of service — creates free consent challenge
statute_currency: CITATION OUT OF DATE - S.92 (exclusion of evidence of oral agreement). The Indian Evidence Act, 1872 was repealed with effect from 1 July 2024 by the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023. The principle relied on here survives the repeal, but the SECTION NUMBER does not carry across - the Adhiniyam renumbered throughout. Published correspondence tables circulating online disagree with one another, so the advocate must map this citation against the bare Adhiniyam text rather than a table, and record the confirmed section here.
